info.name: decidiq-document-accessibility
info.description:
Wire contract of the document accessibility check (openspec/changes/document-accessibility-check):

  POST /api/accessibility/scan           accessibility#scan   400 / 200 pass / 200 fail / 403 / 401
  POST /api/agendas/{meetingId}/publish  agenda#publish       409 accessibility-gate in block and warn mode, acknowledged warn publishes, mode off unchanged

The two papers are the Playwright fixtures in tests/e2e/fixtures (a tiny tagged PDF and a scanned-image PDF without a text layer), stored as plain text through OpenRegister's files API. Self-contained and idempotent: it seeds what it needs, switches the enforcement mode, and restores the previous settings and deletes its objects in teardown.

item.name: Publish in block mode without a reason (409)
Publish in block mode with only an acknowledgement (409)
item.description: Block mode needs a reason; acknowledging is what warn mode asks for and is not enough here.

item.name: Publish in warn mode without acknowledging (409)
Publish in mode off (regression: unchanged agenda publication)

exec: pm.test('Mode off: published (2xx) although a paper fails the scan', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.test('Teardown: outsider removed (or already gone)', () => pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
